title: Superconvergence and aliasing saturation in Sloan iteration for spherical integral equations
summary: Sloan iteration raises the convergence order of Galerkin and degenerate-kernel approximations to second-kind integral equations. After quadrature discretization, these become a discrete Galerkin method and a product-integration Nyström method, respectively. How much of this improvement survives quadrature discretization? For zonal integral equations on the sphere, we give a sharp answer by expressing the Sloan error identity in terms of spherical harmonics.
